scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.

The island record covers separate map intervals. The geographic narrative distinguishes Indigenous history, colonial institutions, associated statehood and the republic. The imported footprint was inspected and remains unverified.

Selected passages of Boomert’s field report support named finds and contexts. A modern discovery year is not an ancient occupation date. Mixed deposits and disputed pottery-to-ethnicity associations do not support a simple replacement narrative.
The presidential list places French governors in 1778 to 1784; this administrative interval is distinct from the 1783 treaty settlement. No unsupported exact day of the transfer is supplied.

The colonial collection introduction supplies broad economic and political chronology; its first-colonization date and claims of legislative primacy are not used. The dated emancipation distinction is corroborated by the Division of Culture.

The community territory account is used for dispossession and institutional continuity. Uncorroborated migration details, present population totals and the claimed survival of particular language fluency are omitted.
The Smithsonian catalogue was accessible through indexed full catalogue text while its direct rendered page intermittently failed. The named basket was purchased from its maker, not excavated.
Kalinago Barana Aute is explicitly a model cultural village. Public demonstrations are evidence of present cultural work, not proof of unchanged ancient practice.
The music and dance articles were published in 1994. Their descriptions are not misrepresented as a newly launched 2026 project. Generalized claims about colonial drum bans are not used.

The Constitution Order’s opening preamble and commencement provisions support independence on 3 November 1978. The full amended statute has not been reviewed, and no claim about current officeholders is made.
No successor links or exact archaeological founding date are invented. Independent review and depth certification remain pending.
